weekend_race.race_comments: Corey Heim won the North Carolina Education Lottery 200 at Charlotte Motor Speedway, his 15th NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series victory. Prior to the green flag to start the race, the following trucks dropped to the rear of the field for the reasons indicated: No. 66 (backup truck), Nos. 2, 22, 33, 90 (unapproved adjustments).
